t2i_prompt: Landscape web page mockup styled as an engineering revision register: a warm cream sheet inset in a deep navy surround with a faint blueprint grid and drawing-frame zone ticks, title block in a corner. Header with a mono wordmark, vertical divider and register title; a row of bracketed filter tags beneath. Left, a narrow featured card with a small P&ID line sketch; right, a wide ruled table with columns for date, document number, topic, subject and standard: <CONTENT>. Monospaced type throughout, thin 1 px rules, square corners, flat, navy and cream only.
signature_idea: News is presented as a controlled document register with doc numbers and governing standards, the way QA logs revisions.
strengths: speaks the QA/document-control language buyers trust
every note tied to a standard
weaknesses: very dense, all-mono and visually dry
featured note too small to draw a reader
no steel-blue accent to guide the eye
image repeats the same layout twice
brand_fit_why: Navy/limestone and square precise rules fit, but mono-only type, missing accent and crowded table lose the light headlines and space-as-material.
